purpose: Specify a compact, sharded, globally checkable order-7 certificate architecture using selector-guarded proof lifting, retained compressed DRAT shards, transient LRAT replay, and a separately certified exact symmetry cover.
claim_boundary: This file is a design and a hard storage envelope. It is not authorization to launch, is not evidence about any unsampled pair, and is not an order-7 UNSAT certificate.

sharding.retention: Retain only zstd-19 compressed lifted DRAT shards plus hashes and indices. For every shard, regenerate LRAT transiently with pinned drat-trim, verify it with lrat-check, and delete the transient raw DRAT/LRAT only after both checks pass.

hard_storage_gate.semantics: A future runner must atomically abort before any per-shard or cumulative cap is exceeded. The caps bound storage safety; they do not guarantee that all proofs fit.

exact_cover_requirements.side_model_list: Directly check every one of the 191,394 listed 30-bit assignments satisfies the independently reconstructed side formula.
exact_cover_requirements.side_model_exhaustion: Produce and retain a checked DRAT-to-LRAT proof that the side formula plus one 30-literal blocking clause for every listed model is UNSAT.
exact_cover_requirements.finite_orbit_partition: Recompute the 294 H actions, 664 H classes, six common multipliers, color-complementing swap, and all 37,194 pair representatives from the certified model list.
exact_cover_requirements.global_symmetry_link: Check every action generator preserves the normalized global formula and fixed units, and check the exact signed action on pair cubes.
exact_cover_requirements.shard_partition: Check every pair-schedule index occurs in exactly one of the 128 shard cover clauses.
